newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India seeks fourth fuel oil cargo for September.
newsitem.headline: India seeks fourth fuel oil cargo for September.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy its fourth cargo of fuel oil for delivery in September, traders said on Friday.
IOC seeks a 25,000 tonne cargo of 180 centistoke, 3.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery between September 25-29 to Goa or Kandla on the Indian west coast.
The tender closes at 0900 hours Indian time on September 5 with offers valid until 2200 hours September 6.

IOC had earlier this week issued two tenders to buy fuel oil. On Monday, it sought a cargo for delivery September 11-15 to Goa/Kandla followed by another tender on Tuesday for two cargoes for September 16-20 delivery to Goa/Kandla and Vizag/Haldia on the east coast.
The earlier tenders close on August 29 and September 5 respectively.
